text: The accepted flowed-text helper turns tab expansion and selected spaces into  , while preserving the final ordinary space when wrapping is allowed. Line_convert_whitespace tracks tag/quote state and leaves tag contents unchanged. This explains why the loop counters and convert_all_whitespace flag exist. No MIME rendering, quoting or charset tests were run. This is source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. title: Whitespace conversion preserves wrap points outside HTML tags
